body.p: Please amend the claims as follows:

br.br:
1. (Original) A wearable device, having a screen, a first electrode, a second electrode, and a circuit board, wherein the first electrode is connected to the screen and does not shield a display region of the screen, the second electrode is mounted on a housing of the wearable device, and the first electrode and the second electrode are electrically connected by using the circuit board; and
in a thickness direction of the wearable device, the first electrode has a first surface, the second electrode has a second surface, and the first surface and the second surface are used to contact a human body.
2. (Original) The wearable device according to claim 1, wherein a groove is disposed in the screen, the groove is disposed on a side of the screen facing a user, and the first electrode is disposed along the groove.
3. (Original) The wearable device according to claim 2, wherein the first electrode is made of a nanometal.
4. (Original) The wearable device according to claim 3, wherein a plurality of grooves are disposed in the screen, the grooves are distributed in a form of a grid, a nanometal is disposed in each groove, and adjacent nanometals are connected to each other to form the first electrode.
5. (Original) The wearable device according to claim 2, wherein the screen has a third surface away from the circuit board, and the groove is disposed in the third surface; and
a conductive protective layer is disposed on the third surface, and the conductive protective layer at least covers a region in which the first electrode is located, and is electrically connected to the first electrode.
6. (Original) The wearable device according to claim 5, wherein the first electrode has a first main body part, a second main body part, and a connecting section; the first main body part is disposed in the groove, the second main body part is disposed on a side of the screen away from the third surface, and is configured to electrically connect to the circuit board; and the first main body part and the second main body part are electrically connected by using the connecting section.
7. (Original) The wearable device according to claim 1, wherein the housing is connected to the screen, and at least a portion of the housing is made of a conductive ceramic that is configured to form the first electrode.
8. (Original) The wearable device according to claim 7, wherein the first electrode is in a form of a ring and is sleeved to the screen.
9. (Original) The wearable device according to claim 7, wherein the wearable device further comprises an elastic part through which the first electrode is electrically connected to the circuit board.
10. (Currently Amended) The wearable device according to claim 1 any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein the housing has a fourth surface away from the screen, and the second electrode is disposed on the fourth surface.
11. (Original) The wearable device according to claim 10, wherein the housing comprises a bottom housing that is located on a side of the wearable device facing the human body; and
the fourth surface is located on the bottom housing.
12. (Original) The wearable device according to claim 10, wherein the wearable device comprises a plurality of second electrodes.
13. (Currently Amended) The wearable device according to claim 1 any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein the wearable device further comprises an electrocardiogram module, and the electrocardiogram module is electrically connected to the first electrode and the second electrode by using the circuit board.
14. (Currently Amended) The wearable device according to claim 1 any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein the wearable device further comprises a photoplethysmography module that is mounted on the housing and configured to detect a heart rate of the human body.
